messages:
Nora (Luminary): hey team ":wave:" — kicking off Luminary onboarding. Goals: 1) auto-summarize device alerts into 1-paragraph notes, 2) provide vector search over 3 months of logs, 3) pilot at 750 req/day. POC: Nora. Need owners, success criteria, and a tight 30/60/90 plan.

Marta (CSM): hi Nora, I’ll coordinate CS activities and acceptance tests. Is renewal tied to a specific accuracy or latency metric?

Nora (Luminary): yes — renewal depends on summary accuracy >=90% on our test set and P95 latency <700ms. Data residency: EU-west.

Diego (Solutions Eng): I’ll lead the integration. Suggest chat-based summaries + embeddings for search. Need sample payloads, avg tokens, and peak traffic shape.

Nora (Luminary): sending 48h sample to S3 in the invite. Avg tokens ~240, peaks 800 events/min during incidents. VPC + KMS should be fine.

Priya (Enablement): enablement plan: dev walkthrough day 2, ops/runbook day 11. I’ll post a pre-read with IAM steps and test prompts.

Asha (Security): flagging retention + auditability. Marta, capture whether deletion-on-request is required — might affect deployment choice.

Marta (CSM): noted. Draft success criteria: - Accuracy >=90% on gold set, - P95 <700ms, - Stable 750 req/day with <1% error, - Security sign-off for EU residency.

Diego (Solutions Eng): quick milestones:
Week 1: keys, allowlist, smoke test (curl)
Week 2: ingestion + embeddings + baseline evals
Week 3: prompt tuning, latency tuning, canary
Week 4: pilot + acceptance tests

Diego (Solutions Eng): smoke curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -d '{"model":"rwd-chat-1","input":"Summarize alert for device X"}'` — please test and confirm egress.

Marta (CSM): proposed kickoff Wed 10:00 CET or Thu 15:00 CET. Which works for you all?

Nora (Luminary): Wed 10:00 CET works. Attendees: Nora, Malik (Eng Lead), Asha, Diego, Priya, Marta.

cal-bot: Meeting created: Wed 10:00 CET — "Luminary  Redwood Onboarding Kickoff".

Marta (CSM): CS action items: collect allowlist IPs, sample S3 link, legal contact, and finalize acceptance tests. Any immediate risks?

Nora (Luminary): risk: compressed binary payloads may need parser work — will include decompression script. See you Wed. :rocket:
